description: This file defines a static factory class WebDriverFactory that creates instances of IWebDriver for Selenium tests. It supports both local browser drivers (Chrome, Firefox, Edge) and remote WebDriver servers, with options for headless operation and configuration via settings. The class includes methods for constructing browser-specific options and handling connection errors.

classes.name: WebDriverFactory
classes.description: Static class providing methods to create IWebDriver instances based on configuration settings.

methods.name: CreateIfEnabled
methods.description: Creates an IWebDriver instance if discovery is not in discovery-only mode; otherwise returns null. Chooses between local and remote driver creation based on settings.

methods.name: CreateRemote
methods.description: Creates a RemoteWebDriver using specified remote URL and browser capabilities.

methods.name: BuildChromeOptions
methods.description: Constructs ChromeOptions with specified headless state and common arguments.

methods.name: BuildEdgeOptions
methods.description: Constructs EdgeOptions with specified headless state and common arguments.

methods.name: BuildFirefoxOptions
methods.description: Constructs FirefoxOptions with specified headless state.

methods.name: CreateChrome
methods.description: Creates a ChromeDriver instance with configured options.

methods.name: CreateEdge
methods.description: Creates an EdgeDriver instance with configured options.

methods.name: CreateFirefox
methods.description: Creates a FirefoxDriver instance with configured options.
